backup.title: Backup & Restore
backup.intro: Downloads an encrypted file containing your entire VyManager setup: user accounts, sites, instances (including API keys and SSH keys), RBAC grants, and OIDC providers.
backup.secretsWarning: This file contains secrets. It is encrypted with the passphrase below — store both safely. The passphrase cannot be recovered if lost.
backup.passTooShort: Passphrase must be at least 8 characters

restore.applianceNotice: This device only restores a backup of this router. A backup with other sites or instances is refused for both merge and replace.
restore.mergeHint: Add missing records and update existing ones. Nothing is deleted.
restore.replaceHint: Wipe all current VyManager data and restore the backup exactly. You will be signed out and must log in with a restored account.
restore.sshKeysWarning: Encrypted SSH keys were created on a different host and cannot be restored here; re-run SSH key setup per instance.
restore.fileAndPassRequired: Select a backup file and enter its passphrase

bugReport.title: Report a Bug
bugReport.description: File a GitHub issue using your own GitHub account.
bugReport.notConfigured: Bug reporting is not configured on this server.
bugReport.authExpired: The authorization request expired. Please try again.
bugReport.titleTooShort: Please enter a short title (at least 3 characters).
bugReport.descriptionTooShort: Please describe the problem (at least 10 characters).
bugReport.connectIntro: Connect your GitHub account to submit a report. We never see or store your GitHub password, and the connection is used only to create this one issue.
bugReport.step2: 2. Open GitHub, paste the code, and authorize:
bugReport.descriptionPlaceholder: What happened? What did you expect? Steps to reproduce.
bugReport.autoAttached: Recent errors were detected and attached automatically. Review and edit or clear them below.
bugReport.errorPlaceholder: Paste any error message or stack trace here
bugReport.includeDiagnostics: Include basic diagnostics (browser and current page). No router configuration is attached.
bugReport.redactionNotice: Sensitive data (public IPs, passwords, keys, certificates) is automatically redacted. You will review the final report before it is sent.
bugReport.previewNotice: This is exactly what will be posted to GitHub. Anything detected as sensitive has been replaced with [REDACTED]. Review it before submitting.
